replies.body:
What should we call you: Gaming or Slaya
Age: 13
Past Teams (Can include OCN): OCN: Radical and Slivers 
Pros: I am really good at swords. I am really good at my ninja bridges. I am very calm during scrims. I'm positive you'll see a positive impact on the team if I join. I am on so much that I think I no-life.
Cons: I am not that good with a bow and I mostly play OCN (idk if thats a con but that means that I barely play Avicus).
Skype: iSlaya or TheGamingSlaya

I also have my own scrimmage server ;).
